metadata.case_name: LAI KA YIN v. CHAN YIU KEI

plaintiff.occupation_before: attendant of a school bus for children attending kindergarten
plaintiff.occupation_after: attendant of a school bus for primary school children

injuries.description: whiplash injury / soft tissue injury of the neck
source: She was diagnosed with a whiplash injury, and received physiotherapy treatment from October 2006 to November 2006.
Both doctors agree that Madam Lai suffered from soft tissue injury of the neck, and soft tissue injury of the back.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the back
source: Madam Lai sustained injuries to her neck and the back as a result, and was hospitalized for 3 days.
Both doctors agree that Madam Lai suffered from soft tissue injury of the neck, and soft tissue injury of the back.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis, unspecified

injuries.description: congenital abnormality of the left forearm, without the part of her limb from the forearm downwards
source: Madam Lai has congenital abnormality of the left forearm, without the part of her limb from the forearm downwards.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the elbow or forearm

manifestations.description: mild tenderness over her neck region
tenderness over the bilateral trapezius muscles
limb numbness (complained but no actual neurological deficit was found)
good range of neck movement and back movement
on and off pain in the neck and back

treatments_received: physiotherapy treatment from October 2006 to November 2006
physiotherapy treatment from Kowloon Hospital on 20 November 2006, 22 November 2006, 27 November 2006 and 1 December 2006
attended the clinic of a general practitioner, Dr. Chu, on a weekly basis from 21 November 2006 with a total of 27 visits
Dr. Chu prescribed medication on each visit and gave 7 days sick leave on each occasion
sick leave by the Hospital from 25 September 2006 to 1 November 2006
Medical expenses have been agreed at $1,721.
Towing fees and the motor survey report fee, totaling $1,050, are also agreed.
treatments_future: no further physiotherapy or other surgery is required for Madam Lai

losses.description: Pain suffering and loss of amenities
